description: NaAu(S₂O₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.46 Å) and four longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Au is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. All Au-O bond lengths are 2.04 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-47°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.64 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 19°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.43-1.68 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Au and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two S atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Au and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom.
